summary: Validated P0 portrait-fullview modal + new DJ Screen feature (Pantalla del DJ) end-to-end as Maestro. 9/9 backend tests PASS (auth flows, GET/PUT dj-screen, sync-players idempotent, group chat post+get, peers, portrait endpoint, 403 for non-member on GET/PUT/chat). 100% of UI flows PASS: P0 portrait click opens portrait-fullview-modal with image + close button; the modal closes correctly. DJ Screen page loads with the 3 zones (initiative-tracker, hero-cards, dj-chat-card, dj-notes-textarea). sync-players-btn pulls the accepted character Regred Maggot into hero-cards (1 card) and the initiative tracker. Adding an enemy via enemy-* inputs + add-enemy-btn creates the combatant. HP +/- buttons mutate HP (15→13). combatant-cond-input Enter adds 'envenenado' pill. turn-next-btn advances 'Turno de …' (Regred→Orco). sort-init-btn reorders by initiative desc. combat-reset-btn returns to round 1 (current_turn_index=0). dj-notes-textarea persists after reload (debounced PUT). Combatants persist after reload (Orco QA + Regred Maggot). combatant-remove-* deletes correctly. Chat group send+display works (chat-input + chat-send-btn → chat-messages). chat-tab-private:<uid> visible for DM. Hub link open-dj-screen-btn navigates to /campanas/:id/pantalla.

issues: The hero card for Regred Maggot shows 0/20 HP because the character's puntos_golpe_actual is 0 in DB (pre-existing data, NOT a regression). Cosmetic: consider falling back to hp_max if hp_current is null AND hp_max>0, but spec already does (pg_cur = pg_max if None). Here pg_cur is explicitly 0, so behaviour is correct.

critical_code_review_comments: dj_screen_routes.py — _sanitize_for_player correctly strips notes_private, combatant.notes and enemy exact HP/AC (returns only hp_band qualitative). Player view safe.
sync_players is idempotent (existing_char_ids gate). Verified by 2nd call returning added=0.
_can_access_channel restricts private:<uid> to that exact user OR DM/Maestro. Group channel needs any membership. Correctly enforced.
Chat list query uses (campaign_run_id, channel) — recommend adding a Mongo index on these fields plus created_at for scale; not critical for MVP.
GET dj-screen returns 200 even when there is no screen yet (lazy create via _ensure_screen). Good UX.

DjScreenPage.jsx onNotesChange debounces 800ms but uses stale closure on `screen` inside setTimeout — works because it builds the payload from current `screen` captured at call time but if a combat update lands between, notes save might overwrite combatants. Low risk because each persist() awaits server, but consider building payload from the latest functional state.

CharacterHeader.jsx — fullview modal added with portrait-fullview-modal/image/close testids. Click target is the portrait image (cursor-pointer). The previous 'click to regen' button is correctly hidden when isLocked (absolute inset-0 overlay only renders in the !isLocked branch), so no overlay blocks the new click.
Hub button open-dj-screen-btn correctly navigates to /campanas/:id/pantalla and route is registered in App.js (DjScreenPage).
